messages:
incident-bot: Pager: high-error-rate detected on dedicated pool aukland-dedicated-canary (tenant: aukland-health). 5xx spike >= 8% over 5m. Escalating to on-call.
Maya (on-call SRE): acked. I’m looking. paging policy triggered to SRE rotation.
Maya (on-call SRE): quick summary from metrics: canary nodes returning 502/503 on generator path. latency up from 120ms -> 900ms for canary fraction (~3% traffic).
Liam (SRE): adding logs from the canary nodes now — give me 30s. Also tagging eng-runtime.
Sophia (eng-runtime): on it. any recent artifact rollouts to that dedicated pool?
Maya (on-call SRE): yes, a canary rollout this morning — artifact sha: ab12cd34 pinned as canary on pool aukland-dedicated-canary ~02:10 UTC.
Oliver (solutions): cc @Diana — we saw a small uptick during your morning traffic ramp?
Diana (Aukland Health POC): We had a scheduled batch ingest at ~02:15 UTC. We paused it when we saw errors, will keep paused until you say clear.
Liam (SRE): here's a tail sample from the runtime logs:```
[2026-03-15T02:29:35Z] request_id=xyz svc=generator err="kv cache miss + OOM during attention_kv_alloc"
[2026-03-15T02:29:35Z] traceback: oom when allocating 1.2GB for KV cache
```
Sophia (eng-runtime): OOM in KV cache allocation rings alarm bells — looks like the canary artifact may have a slightly different KV layout or memory profile. Could be larger embedding table due to debug flags.
Maya (on-call SRE): customer impact: ~3% of aukland traffic hitting canary saw elevated errors; other traffic unaffected. Need to contain and roll back canary.
Sophia (eng-runtime): propose immediate steps: 1) pinfreeze the canary artifact to prevent further progression; 2) divert canary traffic back to stable pool (aukland-dedicated-stable); 3) scale down canary nodes to 0 (drain) while we investigate.
Maya (on-call SRE): agree. Any safety validators before divert? We should keep a small snapshot for forensic logs.
Liam (SRE): snapshot created: s3://redwood-incident-archive/3301112222/snapshot-logs.tar.gz. I’ve also captured a core dump from one canary node.
Oliver (solutions): I'll coordinate the customer communication. @Diana — we'll divert you to stable now, so errors should stop within a minute. We'll keep you posted.
Sophia (eng-runtime): executing steps now. CLI commands:```
# pinfreeze artifact for canary pool
redwood deploy pinfreeze --pool aukland-dedicated-canary --artifact ab12cd34
# divert traffic to stable
redwood routing update --policy auction --pool aukland-dedicated-canary --divert-to aukland-dedicated-stable --percent 100
# scale down canary nodes
redwood infra scale --pool aukland-dedicated-canary --replicas 0 --drain
```
incident-bot: Action log: pinfreeze initiated by Sophia at 3301112265.
Maya (on-call SRE): started diversion at 3301112272 — watching metrics.
Liam (SRE): metrics update: errors dropping in the next 30s. 5xx rate for aukland decreased to 0.6% within 60s.
Diana (Aukland Health POC): confirming — errors stopped on our end, thanks.
Sophia (eng-runtime): canary pool scaled to 0, pinned artifact ab12cd34 (no further rollouts). We also disabled debug-flag hook in runtime config for future test runs.
Maya (on-call SRE): handing to Liam for postmortem & follow up. Liam, can you own the RCA and remediation plan?
Liam (SRE): yes. I'll coordinate with eng-runtime. Initial hypothesis: canary artifact increased KV cache allocation size causing OOM under Aukland's request pattern. Action items: run artifact profiling, reproduce with Aukland's sample prompts, add guardrail to runtime to refuse artifacts > X MB for dedicated canaries, add an alert for KV allocation OOM.
Oliver (solutions): I'll send a brief customer-facing note: "We detected elevated errors during a canary rollout, immediately diverted traffic back to stable, and paused the canary. No further customer impact expected. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."
Diana (Aukland Health POC): appreciated. please include ETA for next safe rollout.
Liam (SRE): ETA: preliminary RCA by EOD, fix + safe re-roll plan by tomorrow morning PST.
Maya (on-call SRE): closing incident thread from on-call perspective. tagging follow-ups: #postmortems and eng-runtime for the RCA. Marking priority P2 now that customer impact resolved. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident closed for pager rule aukland-dedicated-canary at 3301112380 (status: mitigated).
